body:
## What & why

On a 4K@144 DisplayPort link with DSC + VRR, the monitor briefly blanks / re-syncs
("flash") on alt-tab to/from the app — and only this app triggers it. Root cause:
the app's video surface (borderless, client-filling, opaque, flip-model) is the only
surface on the machine eligible for a DWM hardware-overlay / **independent-flip** plane,
so DWM promotes it on focus-gain and demotes it on focus-loss. That per-focus-edge
scanout-plane retopology re-trains the DSC/VRR display link → the flash.

**Fix:** a sub-unity DirectComposition opacity effect (0.99) on the video visual forces
DWM to alpha-blend it, which is inexpressible as an MPO overlay (no constant-alpha plane
mode) — so the plane is pinned to `Composed: Flip`. No promotion churn, no re-train.

## Evidence (PresentMon, `PresentMode` column)

| | foreground present mode |
|---|---|
| Before | predominantly `Hardware Composed: Independent Flip` |
| After | **592/592** `Composed: Flip` (foreground); **1104/1104**, 0 transitions across a 45s real-use alt-tab capture |

The churn is eliminated at the objective layer. The physical flash has not recurred in
testing, but the symptom is intermittent, so long-run real-use confirmation is ongoing.
Mechanism confidence ~0.65 (the final causal link — plane retopology *alone* re-training
the link — is inferred, not documented end-to-end).

## Changes

- `compositor.rs`: occlusion/minimize standby for the render pump; force-composed video plane (the flash fix). Net `+46/-2`.
- `docs/adr/0002-force-composed-video-plane.md`: the decision record, incl. rejected alternatives.
- `docs/feature-contracts/desktop-shell.md`: render-policy note on the forced composition.

## Caveats

- **SDR-coupled:** forcing composition also defeats HDR passthrough. Inert today (8-bit SDR swapchain), but the effect must be gated off if HDR is ever enabled. Documented in ADR-0002.
- Video loses the independent-flip fast path (minor power/GPU cost) — the deliberate trade.

## Note for the merger

History includes `2189a91 DIAGNOSTIC (do not merge)` and a focus-gating experiment that
was reverted; they cancel out in the tree. **Squash-merge recommended** to keep `main` clean.
